tagline: Sunburn weekend, Hilltop psy-trance season, and a winter beach circuit that runs from November to March.
summary: Goa is South Asia's anchor music-tourism destination — Sunburn Festival anchors late December at the country's largest electronic gathering, the historic Hilltop psy-trance scene runs full-moon Saturdays through the cool season, and Anjuna and Vagator beach shacks program day-into-night sets from November through March.
whenToBook: Book Sunburn weekend stays 10-12 weeks out — North Goa fills first. Late January is the easiest peak window.
travelNotes: Dabolim (GOI) or Mopa (GOX) airports both serve the state; North Goa (Vagator/Anjuna/Morjim) is the music-tourism core, ~45 minutes from either airport.
peakHook: December stacks Sunburn weekend, Hilltop full-moon Saturdays, and the heaviest international DJ touring window of the South Asian year.

blueprints.title: Sunburn Festival
blueprints.summary: Asia's largest dance music festival, held annually at Vagator with mainstage EDM and Resistance-style techno arenas across three end-of-year days. The booking window for Goa NYE.

blueprints.title: Hilltop Vagator full-moon Saturdays
blueprints.summary: Hilltop's open-air venue runs Saturday programming through Goa's cool season, anchoring the state's psy-trance and progressive scene with full-moon weekends drawing international heads.

blueprints.title: Shiva Valley Monday sessions
blueprints.summary: The original Anjuna beach venue's Monday sessions run sunset into late night with a steady rotation of psytrance and progressive DJs through the cool season.
